void display() {
  glClear(GL_COLOR_BUFFER_BIT | GL_DEPTH_BUFFER_BIT);
  glLoadIdentity();
  glPushAttrib(GL_ALL_ATTRIB_BITS);
  float A[8], B[8], C[8];
--- render_state ---
  glEnable(GL_MULTISAMPLE);
  glDisable(GL_LINE_SMOOTH);
--- camera ---
  glTranslatef(0.0000f, 0.0000f, -3.0000f);
  glRotatef(0.0000f, 1.0f, 0.0f, 0.0f);
  glRotatef(0.0000f, 0.0f, 1.0f, 0.0f);
  glTranslatef(-0.0000f, -0.0000f, -0.0000f);
--- header_post ---
--- source ---
  triangle() {
    glBegin(GL_TRIANGLES);
      glNormal3f(0, 0, 1);
      glVertex3f(0, 0.8, 0);
      glVertex3f(-0.7, -0.4, 0);
      glVertex3f(0.7, -0.4, 0);
    glEnd();
  }
  // @cfg vertex_points = 0
  glClearColor(0.1, 0.1, 0.1, 1);
  glEnable(GL_DEPTH_TEST);
  glColor3f(1, 0.3, 0.3);
  triangle();
  glTranslatef(2, 0, 0);
  glColor3f(0.3, 1, 0.3);
  triangle();
  glTranslatef(-4, 0, 0);
  glColor3f(0.3, 0.3, 1);
  triangle();
